competitors.name: Weight Supply
competitors.observation: Publishes a fixed range from a commercial trigger; the guide excludes that figure and teaches buyers to align the scope and milestones.

competitors.name: Ivanko
competitors.observation: Uses customer approval and payment as schedule conditions for one program; the guide generalizes only the need to define a trigger.

competitors.name: OKPRO
competitors.observation: Combines sourcing, customization and schedule language; the new guide adds a buyer-controlled critical-path and evidence matrix.

rejectedTopics: Sample approval for OEM free weights — already published in every active locale.
Custom logo method comparison — existing multilingual guide covers molded, printed, engraved and end-cap routes.
MOQ scope and mixed-SKU planning — published on the previous daily run.
Export packaging — existing guide owns the primary packaging intent.
AQL inspection — existing guide owns the acceptance-sampling intent.
siteGaps: No existing article defines the start and finish of a custom free-weight production schedule or maps product, branding, packaging, inspection and handoff dependencies in one buyer file.

searchRun.provider: DataForSEO Google and Bing results, People Also Ask extraction, Reddit buyer-language review, competitor review and direct primary-source verification
limitations: Eleven initial tasks returned no result, an upstream error or an unsupported language field.
Quora blocked automated access; no answer text was used.
Competitor durations were treated as supplier-specific and were not reproduced.
No customer, order quantity, price, duration, capacity, certification or performance result was inferred from public pages.

sources.title: ISO 9001 — quality management systems
